title: Vesper and the Will
author: Astrid Montrose
blurb: Isandro Ishikawa, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
